datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2011, classifying geographic units in Djibouti by food insecurity phase and scenario. The data represents near-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions aggregated at the administrative unit level.
